archetype: Melee STR pirate built around a form swap. Normal attacks build Spectra in the base Flora form; spending it enters Specter State, where the Charge Drive line upgrades into stronger versions. Damage output is tied to keeping Specter State up and aligning cooldowns with it.

linkSkill.name: Solus
linkSkill.effect: Percent damage that accumulates in stacks while the character stays in a combat state, then falls off when combat lapses.

levels.2: +2% damage per stack, up to +11% total
levels.3: +3% damage per stack, up to +16% total

linkSkill.note: Name agreed by all sources. Numbers disagree: see conflicts.

legionEffect.effect: Flat STR, scaling with the character's level tier: +10 / +20 / +40 / +80 / +100.

priority.why: Listed in the primary boost-node group on the only source current to GMS v.269. That source defines primary groups as frequently used skills whose boost node also unlocks a 6th job HEXA Mastery.
Second primary boost-node group on the same v.269-current source.
Third primary boost-node group on the v.269-current source. Scarlet Charge Drive also carries a critical rate buff, which changes how much critical rate needs to be bought elsewhere.

priority.why: Marked secondary (not primary) on the v.269-current source. Older guides put Basic Charge Drive in the first trio instead; see conflicts.

priority.why: Categorised as other (lowest tier) on the v.269-current source, but as first-trio material in the 2021 and 2024 guides. Contested; see conflicts.
Categorised as other on the v.269-current source; appears in the second trio of the 2021 guide.

trios.dated: 2021-12-05 and 2024-09-16, both pre-dating the current patch

Third trio in the 2021 guide, with the third slot left flexible. Only one source; treat as unverified.

vMatrix.notes: Recency warning. The only source current to a 2026 patch (GMS v.269) groups nodes by importance rather than into trios, and its ranking disagrees with the 2021/2024 trio lists: it treats the enhanced-form drives (Abyssal, Gust, Scarlet) as primary and puts Basic Charge Drive one tier lower, with Ominous Nightmare and Impending Death lower still. No source consulted stated how the ordering shifts between Lv 200 and Lv 260, so that question is left unanswered rather than guessed.

utilityNodes.why: Listed as the class-agnostic 5th job picks alongside Ark's own nodes.

originSkill.name: Primordial Abyss
originSkill.effect: Draws additional Specter power through the enhanced body and arm. Succeeding with a Basic Charge Drive combo generates spectral energy, which is then spent to produce abyssal blades; the energy pool caps at 300. Also functions as a bind and an invincibility window.

order.why: The Origin skill unlocks at the 6th job advancement without a Sol Erda cost, so it is free to turn on before anything else.

order.step: Activate the HEXA Mastery node(s) next
order.why: Activating nodes is cheaper per point of damage than levelling any single node, so unlocking the Mastery node comes before pouring Sol Erda into levels.

order.step: Activate Boost nodes after the Mastery node
order.why: Same reasoning: activate everything before levelling anything.

order.step: Defer HEXA Stat until it out-earns further HEXA Skill levels
order.why: Stated as the crossover condition for switching investment from skill levels to HEXA Stat.

hexa.notes: No Ark-specific HEXA investment order was found in any source consulted, and no source listed Ark's Mastery core names or its Ascent skill core. The v.269-current class page states only that a boost node counted as primary is one that unlocks a 6th job HEXA Mastery and belongs to a frequently used skill, which implies (but does not state) that the Abyssal, Gust and Scarlet Charge Drive lines carry the Masteries. The one HEXA guide located explicitly defers class-by-class ordering to the class Discord infographics, which were not reachable. These fields are left empty deliberately; inventing a core order would misdirect Sol Erda spending for months.

priority.why: Named alongside IED as the bossing priority.
Scarlet Charge Drive supplies 20% critical rate, so buying past about 80% from other sources is wasted.

hyperStats.notes: Single-source and pre-HEXA. No post-2025 Ark hyper stat ordering was found, and no source gave level-by-level targets, so the usual Critical Damage / Damage / ATT ordering is deliberately not recorded here. The Scarlet Charge Drive critical rate claim should be re-checked in game before acting on it, since skill values have been revised since 2021.

passive.name: Enhanced Specter Healing (also written Enhanced Spectra Healing)
passive.why: Recommended by every source consulted; one source prefers it over the Specter State enhancement for steadier Spectra recovery.

passive.name: Enhanced Specter State
passive.why: Third passive on the v.269-current source; the 2021/2024 guides pick Guardbreak Arts and the triple-dash Tenacious Instinct enhancement instead. See conflicts.

passive.name: Euphoric Restraint or Swift Creeping Terror
passive.why: Offered as the flexible final passive on the v.269-current source.

passive.name: Guardbreak Arts
passive.why: Picked by the 2021 and 2024 guides; absent from the v.269-current source's recommended build.

passive.name: Incredibly Tenacious Instinct
passive.why: Picked by the 2021 and 2024 guides for the third dash charge; absent from the v.269-current source's build.

hyperSkills.notes: Skill names appear as both Specter and Spectra across sources; they refer to the same skills. The passive set is contested between the current class page and the older guides.

bossing.why: Raises the level cap on passives, which is why it is taken as the prime line.

bossing.line: Buff Duration +38%, or Damage against enemies with an abnormal status +8%
bossing.why: The abnormal-status line pairs with sources of status effects such as the Magician link skill.

culvert.line: Passive Skills +1 / Boss Damage +10% / Cooldown Skip +10%

training.line: Meso and Drop Rate lines, or Damage to Normal Monsters +8%

innerAbility.notes: One 2024 source instead recommends ATT +30 with Boss Damage +20%, which contradicts the lines above; see conflicts.

gearingNotes: Ark is a STR main / DEX secondary pirate using a Knuckle with the Abyssal Path secondary, so it competes for the same STR gear as other STR pirates. Potential guidance found: one line of Boss Damage, one line of IED, and attack on the remaining lines for weapon, secondary and emblem, with the caveat that in Reboot attack lines tend to be worth more than boss damage, and that IED is also supplied by legion and link skills so it can be topped up outside of potential. That guidance is from a 2021 source and single-sourced. No source consulted gave Ark-specific set goals, arcane or sacred force targets, or anything that makes Ark's gearing differ from a generic STR pirate, so nothing further is recorded.

commonMistakes.mistake: Following a pre-HEXA boost node order as though it were current
commonMistakes.detail: The 2021 and 2024 guides lead with Basic Charge Drive, Impending Death and Ominous Nightmare, while the page current to GMS v.269 ranks the enhanced-form drives (Abyssal, Gust, Scarlet) highest and pushes those three down one or two tiers. Boost node crafting is expensive to redo.

commonMistakes.mistake: Buying critical rate up to 100% from hyper stats
commonMistakes.detail: Scarlet Charge Drive is reported to supply 20% critical rate, so roughly 80% from other sources is the target. Single-sourced and dated 2021; verify in game.

commonMistakes.mistake: Letting Specter State lapse or misaligning cooldowns with it
commonMistakes.detail: Ark's damage skills upgrade while in Specter State, so the class rewards keeping the form up and firing cooldowns inside it.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: hexa.originSkill.effect states Primordial Abyss 'Also functions as a bind and an invincibility window'. The cited DigitalTQ 6th job entry gives the 300 spectral energy cap and 'invincible during casting' but says nothing about a bind. The bind is unsourced.
hexa.originSkill cites https://grandislibrary.com/flora/ark as a source. That page contains no 6th Job / HEXA section and no Origin skill name. Only the DigitalTQ 6th job guide supports this.
sources[0].what claims the Grandis Ark page provides '6th job skill names'. It does not - it has no 6th job content.

vMatrix.priority[2].why attributes the Scarlet Charge Drive critical rate buff partly to Grandis, which carries no Scarlet Charge Drive description. The only origin is The Digital Crowns (2021): '100% critical rate is important but you only need 80% because using Scarlet Charge Drive gives you 20%.'

innerAbility.bossing[2] (Buff Duration +38% / abnormal-status +8%) cites thedigitalcrowns.com. That page recommends 'Passive Skills +1 (Prime line), Boss Damage (2nd line), Cooldown Skip (3rd line)' - it supports the culvert entry instead, which is credited to Grandis alone.
